reading.body:
TulsaConnect operates DC-5 in downtown Tulsa on underground power infrastructure with fully redundant A and B power systems, multiple cooling sources, and on-site fiber connectivity. The operator publishes no specific power capacity or square footage for this building, making its scale impossible to determine from public sources.

TulsaConnect describes itself as Oklahoma's oldest locally owned data center operator, in business since 1996, with three geographically diverse facilities totaling over 400 racks company-wide. This downtown facility is one of nine mapped data centers in Oklahoma and the only one in the state with any published power specification, though that specification does not exist, creating a flat ranking by capacity.

The campus location in downtown Tulsa places it within an urban grid rather than at a purpose-built colocation site. Without published power capacity, cooling specifications, or square footage, this facility's relevance to AI infrastructure scaling cannot be assessed from available public data. The operator's company-wide 400-rack figure is too coarse to indicate whether any individual building meets modern AI training density requirements.
